name: 90s-film-lazy-blonde-girl
image_purpose: retro lookbook and editorial lifestyle portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a raw 1990s-inspired editorial portrait of one approved adult woman seated in a worn red leather armchair, preserving the unpolished film texture and layered casual wardrobe.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long voluminous golden-blonde wavy hair, natural flyaways and frizz, pale skin with visible pores and faint freckles, pensive neutral expression and direct eye contact. She wears a fitted light-blue ribbed tank under an oversized cream button-down, distressed light-wash jeans, dirty white high-top canvas sneakers, chunky turquoise and amber rings, uneven beaded bracelets, silver chain, and delicate necklace.
composition_elements: Candid seated pose in a vintage red leather club armchair.
One knee raised toward chest, other leg extended; right elbow on knee with hand gently resting against cheek.
Cluttered interior with weathered blue shelving, dog-eared books, magazines, scattered papers, deep teal walls, pink curtain, and dark scuffed wood floor.
Preserve authentic room mess and tactile worn materials.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Mixed natural window light and direct camera flash, hard shadows behind subject, specular highlights, raw 90s editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Leica M6 with 35mm Summilux look, Kodak Portra 400, 35mm film grain, slight chromatic aberration, high contrast, vivid saturation, slight vignette, no text or watermark.
